pages.title: Heat-Pack Reactor
pages.text: A stirred, jacketed vessel for the reactions that give out or take in heat - run steady, with the outlet held at its temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set how fast the reactants are mixed. The outlet temperature moves with it - up for a reaction that gives out heat, down for one that takes it in - and must sit in each recipe's band. Mixing ammonia and nitric acid too fast runs away: above 450 K ammonium nitrate decomposes. The cold packs are coolants for the physics machines.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 3 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Ammonium Nitrate, Cold Pack Solution, Eutectic Brine.
